grammar.q: Some of the witnesses pretended [ ____ ] the defendant, fearing that their statements might provoke revenge from his powerful family. NEW

The new regulations require all food manufacturers [ ____ ] every ingredient, including those that are present only in tiny amounts. NEW
Patients who understand their treatment tend to be more willing [ ____ ] their doctors’ advice. NEW
The research team expects [ ____ ] evidence of ancient settlements once the excavation reaches the deeper layers of the site, where several clay pots were discovered.
Would you mind [ ____ ] once more how the new tax will affect families with low incomes?
[ ____ ] poetry requires far more than a dictionary, since rhythm and sound carry much of the meaning.
The startup, which had struggled for years to attract investors, could not afford [ ____ ] additional engineers until a major acquisition finally gave it access to generous funding.
Having grown up in a fishing village, the novelist was used to [ ____ ] before dawn.
As soon as the conductor raised his baton, the audience stopped [ ____ ] and the hall fell completely silent.
Both governments agreed [ ____ ] the cost of the research vessel that will map the ocean floor near the pole.
Sleep specialists recommend [ ____ ] exposure to bright screens in the evening, as the light can delay the release of hormones that make us sleepy.
Accepting the scholarship would mean [ ____ ] her family and moving to a country where she knew no one at all.
Far from [ ____ ] the young scientist, the rejection of her first paper by three leading journals made her even more determined to find empirical evidence for her hypothesis.
It was generous [ ____ ] the elderly professor to donate her entire collection of rare books to the library.
The journalist traveled to the remote island [ ____ ] survivors of the storm that the media had ignored.
The workers’ union refused [ ____ ] the management’s offer, arguing that the proposed raise would barely keep pace with inflation and that pensions had already been cut twice.
Many retired people enjoy [ ____ ] at local museums, where their knowledge of history is greatly valued.
[ ____ ] the endangered turtles that nest on the beach, the city has outlawed artificial lighting along the coast.
The newly elected mayor promised [ ____ ] every contract signed by the previous administration, especially those involving highway projects that had been awarded without public review.
Some students keep putting off [ ____ ] their research papers until the night before the deadline.

Learning to read the facial expressions and gestures of people from different cultures [ ____ ] diplomats avoid misunderstandings that could undermine years of careful diplomacy between their governments.
The archaeologists were astonished [ ____ ] that the statues buried beneath the temple were nearly two thousand years older than expected.
In many developing regions, women still lack the opportunity [ ____ ] the kind of education that would allow them to support their families, a form of inequality that persists across generations.
The defense lawyer was skilled at [ ____ ] complicated legal terms in a way that ordinary members of the jury could follow, which proved decisive when the jury’s decision was announced.
Facing a sharp drop in sales during the recession, the company is considering [ ____ ] several of its overseas factories and moving production back home.
It is almost impossible [ ____ ] a single laboratory to test every possible combination of the thousands of chemicals used in modern industry.
I still remember [ ____ ] an article about bees disappearing from farms across Europe, which first made me interested in ecology.
Don’t forget [ ____ ] the cabinet where the confidential documents about the merger are stored.
When it comes to [ ____ ] plastic waste, changes in how products are packaged matter more than individual recycling efforts.
Feeling dizzy from the heat, the runner stopped [ ____ ] some water at a roadside table before going on.
Despite the heavy snow and the risk of further collapse, the rescue workers kept [ ____ ] through the ruins of the hospital throughout the night in the hope of finding more survivors.

Migrants who arrive without speaking the local language often have difficulty [ ____ ] basic services such as health care and legal advice, even when those services are guaranteed by law.

arrange.ko: 고객의 불만에 즉시 대응하지 못하는 것은 회사의 평판을 여러 해 동안 손상시킬 수 있다.
arrange.bogi: can damage / fail / a company’s reputation for many years / to respond immediately to complaints from customers
arrange.ans: Failing to respond immediately to complaints from customers can damage a company’s reputation for many years.

arrange.ko: 그 마을 사람들은 수백 년 동안 마을 역사의 일부였던 오래된 다리를 허무는 데 반대했다.
arrange.bogi: tear down / the villagers / the old bridge that had been part of the town’s history for centuries / objected to
arrange.ans: The villagers objected to tearing down the old bridge that had been part of the town’s history for centuries.

arrange.ko: 개인 정보가 유출된 고객들에게 공개적으로 사과한 것은 그 최고 경영자로서는 용감한 일이었다.
arrange.bogi: apologize publicly / of the CEO / to the customers whose personal data had been leaked / it was brave
arrange.ans: It was brave of the CEO to apologize publicly to the customers whose personal data had been leaked.

arrange.ko: 다른 사람들에게 칭찬받는 것은 좋은 성적을 받는 것보다 아이들에게 동기를 부여하는 데 더 효과적일 수 있다.
arrange.bogi: motivate children / be praised by others / than receiving good grades / can be more effective at
arrange.ans: Being praised by others can be more effective at motivating children than receiving good grades.

arrange.ko: 혼자 있을 때 저지른 실수는 청중 앞에서 저지른 실수보다 대부분의 사람들에게 훨씬 덜 창피하다.
arrange.bogi: are those / mistakes made in private / made in front of an audience / than / are far less embarrassing to most people
arrange.ans: Mistakes made in private are far less embarrassing to most people than are those made in front of an audience.

arrange.ko: 잠은 단지 휴식 시간일 뿐만 아니라 뇌가 배운 것을 정리하는 시간이기도 하다.
arrange.bogi: but also a time / what it has learned / sleep is / when the brain organizes / not merely a period of rest
arrange.ans: Sleep is not merely a period of rest but also a time when the brain organizes what it has learned.

arrange.ko: 그 관리자는 직원들이 일주일에 이틀 넘게 집에서 일한다는 생각이 마음에 들지 않았다.
arrange.bogi: work from home / the idea of / more than two days a week / the manager did not like / his employees
arrange.ans: The manager did not like the idea of his employees working from home more than two days a week.

arrange.ko: 많은 청중 앞에서 말하는 것은 많은 사람들에게 거의 그 어떤 것보다도 더 많은 스트레스를 준다.
arrange.bogi: more stress than almost anything else / causes many people / speak in front of a large audience
arrange.ans: Speaking in front of a large audience causes many people more stress than almost anything else.

arrange.ko: 연구자들은 참가자들에게 다른 누군가가 그들의 팔을 만지는 동안 눈을 감고 있으라고 요청했다.
arrange.bogi: keep their eyes / the researchers / close while someone else touched their arms / asked the participants
arrange.ans: The researchers asked the participants to keep their eyes closed while someone else touched their arms.

arrange.ko: 그 박물관은 그 오래된 그림이 전시될 수 있도록 그것을 복원할지를 결정해야 했다.
arrange.bogi: whether / so that it could be displayed / the museum had to decide / restore the old painting
arrange.ans: The museum had to decide whether to restore the old painting so that it could be displayed.

arrange.ko: Freud는 몸이 입술이 숨기는 것을 드러내기 때문에 누구든 비밀을 지키는 것은 불가능하다고 믿었다.
arrange.bogi: keep a secret since the body reveals what the lips hide / for anyone / Freud believed that / it was impossible
arrange.ans: Freud believed that it was impossible for anyone to keep a secret since the body reveals what the lips hide.

translate.en: It is probably also the reason why being tickled by someone else is more effective at producing an emotional reaction than trying to tickle yourself. 그것은 아마도 또한 다른 사람에게 간지럼을 당하는 것이 스스로를 간지럽히려 하는 것보다 감정적 반응을 일으키는 데 더 효과적인 이유일 것이다.
translate.ko: 어떤 주제를 가르치도록 요청받는 것은 혼자서 그것을 복습하는 것보다 이해를 깊게 하는 데 더 효과적이다.

translate.en: When you move your body and produce tactile sensations, these stimuli are less noticeable to you than are sensations produced by another individual. 여러분이 몸을 움직여 촉각의 감각을 만들어 낼 때, 이 자극은 다른 사람이 만들어 낸 감각보다 여러분에게 덜 두드러진다.
translate.ko: 외부인이 부과한 규칙은 대개 공동체가 스스로 만든 규칙보다 덜 존중받는다.

translate.en: Belonging was not merely a matter of safety but also of survival. 소속감은 단지 안전의 문제일 뿐만 아니라 생존의 문제이기도 했다.
translate.ko: 소설을 읽는 것은 단지 오락의 한 형태일 뿐만 아니라 다른 사람들을 이해하는 방법이기도 하다.

translate.en: Likewise, your reaction to your cat jumping onto your lap is likely to be much greater if you have your eyes closed when it happens. 마찬가지로, 고양이가 여러분의 무릎 위로 뛰어오르는 것에 대한 여러분의 반응은 그 일이 일어날 때 여러분이 눈을 감고 있다면 훨씬 더 클 것이다.
translate.ko: 많은 주민들이 밤늦게 트럭들이 옛 시가지의 좁은 거리를 지나가는 것에 대해 불평했다.

translate.en: Stories influence subtly, invest power, make hidden moral judgement and always distort by omission, whether intentionally or not. 이야기는 미묘하게 영향을 미치고, 권력을 부여하며, 숨겨진 도덕적 판단을 내리고, 의도적이든 아니든 항상 생략을 통해 왜곡한다.
translate.ko: 우리가 하는 모든 선택은, 우리가 그것을 알든 모르든, 우리가 되는 사람을 만들어 간다.

translate.en: When you move your body and produce tactile sensations, these stimuli are less noticeable to you than are sensations produced by another individual.
translate.ko: 여러분이 몸을 움직여 촉각의 감각을 만들어 낼 때, 이 자극은 다른 사람이 만들어 낸 감각보다 여러분에게 덜 두드러진다.

translate.en: The sensations of your own legs touching one another when you cross your legs, for example, are generally less noticeable than a similar touch on your leg would be if someone sitting next to you brushed their leg against yours.
translate.ko: 예를 들어, 다리를 꼬았을 때 자신의 두 다리가 서로 닿는 감각은, 옆에 앉은 누군가가 자기 다리를 여러분의 다리에 스친다면 느껴질 비슷한 접촉보다 일반적으로 덜 두드러진다.

translate.en: Likewise, your reaction to your cat jumping onto your lap is likely to be much greater if you have your eyes closed when it happens.
translate.ko: 마찬가지로, 고양이가 여러분의 무릎 위로 뛰어오르는 것에 대한 여러분의 반응은 그 일이 일어날 때 눈을 감고 있다면 훨씬 더 클 것이다.

translate.en: This differential response to surprising tactile stimuli appears to be a defense mechanism that has adaptive significance.
translate.ko: 놀라운 촉각 자극에 대한 이러한 상이한 반응은 적응상의 의미를 지닌 방어 기제인 것으로 보인다.

translate.en: It is probably also the reason why being tickled by someone else is more effective at producing an emotional reaction than trying to tickle yourself.
translate.ko: 그것은 아마도 또한 다른 사람에게 간지럼을 당하는 것이 스스로를 간지럽히려 하는 것보다 감정적 반응을 일으키는 데 더 효과적인 이유일 것이다.

translate.en: Our enjoyment of being tickled generally diminishes as we age.
translate.ko: 간지럼을 당하는 것에 대한 우리의 즐거움은 나이가 들면서 일반적으로 줄어든다.

translate.en: This is likely due to the fact that adults are better at anticipating stimuli, and hence are more difficult to surprise, than are children.
translate.ko: 이것은 아마도 어른이 아이보다 자극을 더 잘 예상하고, 따라서 놀라게 하기가 더 어렵다는 사실 때문일 것이다.
